mapper.select: select t.job_ins_id, t.product, t.job_id, t.job_state, t.job_name, t.job_mode, t.batch, t.parameters, t.properties, t.accut_date, t.title, t.is_paused, t.version, t.init_time, t.begin_time, t.end_time, t.creator, t.create_time, t.schedule_rid from ww_job_instance t

select t.job_ins_id, t.product, t.job_id, t.job_state, t.job_name, t.job_mode, t.batch, t.parameters, t.properties, t.accut_date, t.title, t.is_paused, t.version, t.init_time, t.begin_time, t.end_time, t.creator, t.create_time, t.schedule_rid, if(t.job_state=2,(select count(1) from ww_task_instance where job_ins_id=t.job_ins_id and (task_state='14' or task_state='16')),0) count_fail_task from ww_job_instance t

select t.job_ins_id, t.product, t.job_id, t.job_state, t.job_name, t.job_mode, t.batch, t.parameters, t.properties, t.accut_date, t.title, t.is_paused, t.version, t.init_time, t.begin_time, t.end_time, t.creator, t.create_time, t.schedule_rid, decode(t.job_state,2,(select count(1) from ww_task_instance where job_ins_id=t.job_ins_id and (task_state='14' or task_state='16')),0) count_fail_task from ww_job_instance t

SELECT j.product,j.batch, COUNT(1) AS total_count, COUNT(IF(t.task_state = 13, TRUE, NULL)) running_count, COUNT(IF(t.task_state = 14, TRUE, NULL)) error_delay_count, COUNT(IF(t.task_state = 15, TRUE, NULL)) feedback_count, COUNT(IF(t.task_state > 19, TRUE, NULL)) passed_count FROM ww_job_instance j left join ww_task_instance t on j.job_ins_id = t.job_ins_id WHERE 1=1
and j.product = #{product}
and instr(j.batch, #{lBatch}) > 0
and exists ( select tsupr.product_id From ww_sys_user tsu,ww_product tp,ww_sys_user_product_ref tsupr where tsu.login_name=tsupr.user_id and tp.p_id=tsupr.product_id and tp.p_id=j.product and tsu.login_name=#{loginName} )
GROUP BY j.product, j.batch ORDER BY j.product, j.batch DESC

SELECT j.product,j.batch, COUNT(1) AS total_count, COUNT(DECODE(SIGN(t.task_state-13),0,1, NULL)) running_count, COUNT(DECODE(SIGN(t.task_state-14),0,1, NULL)) error_delay_count, COUNT(DECODE(SIGN(t.task_state-15),0,1, NULL)) feedback_count, COUNT(DECODE(SIGN(t.task_state-19),1,1, NULL)) passed_count FROM ww_job_instance j left join ww_task_instance t on j.job_ins_id = t.job_ins_id WHERE 1=1
and j.product = #{product}
and instr(j.batch, #{lBatch}) > 0
and exists ( select tsupr.product_id From ww_sys_user tsu,ww_product tp,ww_sys_user_product_ref tsupr where tsu.login_name=tsupr.user_id and tp.p_id=tsupr.product_id and tp.p_id=j.product and tsu.login_name=#{loginName} )
GROUP BY j.product, j.batch ORDER BY j.product, j.batch DESC

select * from ww_job_instance where 1=1
and product in
#{item}
and rownum=1

select * from ww_ds where 1=1
and product in
#{item}
limit 1
